dripping-springs-methodist-tx-gmc.assessment: Hill Country GMC congregation in fast-growing Dripping Springs. Senior Pastor Adam Thornton has led since 2017 and holds graduate degrees from both Austin Presbyterian Seminary and Austin Graduate School of Theology. Mid-Texas Annual Conference.

score_notes.christology: Orthodox per GMC Book of Doctrines
score_notes.cultural: GMC alignment = orthodox sexual ethics post-2022
score_notes.denominational: GMC; listed on Mid-Texas Conference Find-a-Church
